==Usage instructions==
Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page.
<pre><nowiki>{{Device
|image=
|name=
|manufacturer=
|model=
|type=
|culture=
|creators=
|created=
|modifier=
|destroyed=
|discovered=
|owners=
|locations=
|cost=
|value=
|structure=
|size=
|material=
|length=
|width=
|height=
|weight=
|protection=
|capacity=
|range=
|inscription=
|markings=
|purpose=
|heritage=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki></pre>

==Data fields==
*name &ndash; Simply list the name of the device.
*image &ndash; Put a link to the main image which represents the device.
*manufacturer &ndash; Put the manufacturer name here (use <tt>creators</tt> if a specific person created it)
*model &ndash; List the full official device model name
*type &ndash; The type of device (e.g. "Vibroblade" or "Blaster rifle")
*culture &ndash; List the cultures that used the device or cultures in which it is otherwise prominent
*creators &ndash; List the creators of the device (in the case of specific individuals)
*created &ndash; The date the device was created
*modifier &ndash; The being(s) who modified the device
*destroyed &ndash; The date the device was destroyed
*discovered &ndash; The date the device was discovered, if previously lost or hidden
*owners &ndash; List owners of the device only if it is unique
*locations &ndash; List locations where the device was known to be used
*cost &ndash; List the cost of the device (and the currency type if known)
*value &ndash; List the real worth of the device
*structure &ndash; List features of the structure or shape of the device
*size &ndash; Size of the device
*material &ndash; List materials from which the device is made
*length &ndash; Length of the device
*width &ndash; Width of the device
*height &ndash; Height of the device
*weight &ndash; Weight of the device
*protection &ndash; List the types of attacks that the device provided protection against
*capacity &ndash; The capacity of the device
*range &ndash; The range of the device
*inscription &ndash; List any inscriptions on the device
*markings &ndash; List any distinct markings on the device
*purpose &ndash; List any special purposes of the device
*heritage &ndash; The heritage of the device
*affiliation &ndash; List the governments and major organizations that used the device here
